customManagers.description: The aws-cdk release whose bootstrap template pkg/cdkbootstrap vendors. A bump moves VERSION only; the pull request stays red (TestVendoredTemplateMatchesProvenance) until hack/update-cdk-bootstrap.sh has fetched the template of that release.

packageRules.description: The bootstrap template is the stack deployed to every account that carries a bootstrap: a person reads the template diff before it merges, whatever the version step.
